notes.content:
[img]https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/UP_46_Patch_Header_f4e14fd401.png[/img]Although we rarely do this, a new Update is coming this season, to introduce one of our most ambitious features to date: EVO Tuning! 
[h2]    EVO TUNING [/h2]
    [img]https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/EV_Otuning_82bd347470.png[/img]

    Our brand new feature adds a new layer of tuning and power for some classic cars! 

    For our first foray, EVO Tuning will be available for the [b]Bugatti Chiron[/b], the [b]Ferrari Enzo Ferrari[/b] and the [b]Chevrolet Camaro LT[/b]. 

    Once you max these cars, you will automatically unlock the new EVO feature and be able to access it directly from the garage. 

    The EVO feature will allow you to collect new items that unlock new driving experiences for your car: 
[list]    [*]        [b]Collect Items:[/b] Each car will have access to its own EVO shop, allowing you to unlock EVO items such as new engines, drivetrains, nitro systems, etc.     [/*]    [*]        [b]Create your build:[/b] Each item will have a different weight, and the total weight of your car will heavily impact how it performs on the track.     [/*]    [*]        [b]Fine Tuning: [/b]Specific items can provide boosts to key areas, so adapt your choice to your driving style!     [/*][/list]
    We'll be looking forward to all your feedback and impressions in our Discord Channel to help us fine tune and balance this feature so it can evolve it into something special. 

    Yes. Pun fully intended. See you in Discord! 
https://youtu.be/lnKrRYPMaAk
[h2]    EVO SHOP [/h2]
    [img]https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/EV_Oshop_826f5d117e.png[/img]

    When accessing the new EVO Tuning menus, you'll have direct acces to the new EVO Shop. 

    It will feature all the available EVO Items for that car from the start, and you'll be able to spend tickets to choose which Item to reveal and keep first! 

    A bit of luck and you'll have your dream build in no time! 

    4 EVO Shop tickets for that car will be automatically earned as soon as you Max your car. 

    You'll be able to earn more tickets through gameplay, the shop and we even included some in the Legend Pass! 
[h2]    LEGO TECHNIC SPOTLIGHT [/h2]
    [img]https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/LEGO_spotlight_2954341097.png[/img]

    One last sprint alongside LEGO Technic! 

    The new Spotlight event for the season will feature all our released LEGO Technic cars, for you to complete or try to unlock if you're late to the party! 

    Keep an eye out for some special TLEs during the season to get a chance to compete for your very own LEGO Technic Sets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/2d1ea6243abbbc18bd0c46bcc50b7201d953fbc0.png[/img]

    A season of celebrations begins, as this year marks 20 Years of Asphalt! 

    And before the celebrations begin, we wanted to give all our Legends a [b]MASSIVE THANK YOU[/b]! 

    Without you we would have never been able to make this far, and whether you've been with us for 20 years, 20 days or even 20 minutes, we want to thank you for joining us in this amazing journey!

    Now, it's time to buckle up as we're going to take you a nostalgic trip through time.... and space! 

    First, we need to go back to where it all began: 
[h1]    ASPHALT URBAN GT [/h1]
    [img]https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/Asphalt_Urban_GT_Artwork_Key_Visual_logo_1579x1114_338a46cd49.png[/img]

    We've brought our first ever Asphalt game back for the Anniversary! You'll be able to experience our first steps (or laps) for yourself and see how far we've come. 

    Head over to our website once the season starts, and take the old beauty out for a spin. Who knows? You might even get a reward for finishing. 
[h1]    SAN DIEGO HARBOR TRACK REMAKE [/h1]
https://youtu.be/SIvowekmW2Y

    We bring back one of the classic tracks from Asphalt 8... but with a twist! Mysterious teleporters have appeared that will take you through space and time. 

    Not only will you be able to experience a fully re-rendered version of San Diego, but also make a pit stop in the L.A. River with a quick detour through our beloved Cairo track. 

    In case you missed it, check out our exclusive track reveal. 
[h1]    20th ANNIVERSARY SPOTLIGHT[/h1]
    [img]https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/annispot_66f5015366.png[/img]

    We've had to get bigger light bulbs for this one, just to be able to shine a light on all the cars included! 

    We're featuring 20 classic Asphalt cars for you to race with, and you can check the full list in our event preview below. 

    The Anniversary event will also feature a Spotlight Pass, including some specially themed Anniversary decals! 
[h2]    CELEBRATE WITH US! [/h2]
    Not only do we have great events in-game but there's also more goodies to be had by joining our community: 
[list]    [*]        [b]FREE CODES: [/b]Not only do you get some freebies just for logging in during the anniversary, but we'll be celebrating 20 Days of Free Codes on our socials! Make sure to follow!     [/*]    [*]        [b]ANNIVERSARY ACE CHALLENGE: [/b]You've already seen our qualifiers as we gear up to the Grand Finals on August 15th! Don't miss the show for more free codes!     [/*][/list][h1]    DRIVE SYNDICATE 12 [/h1]
    [img]https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/ds12_b41dec5638.png[/img]

    The latest entry in the Drive Syndicate saga and featuring one of the most powerful line-ups in history! 

    Take the wheel of the Arash Imperium and experience what it truly means to dominate the streets. 
[h1]    NEW CUSTOMIZATION SYSTEM [/h1]
    [img]https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/custom_e6adcc23ea.png[/img]

    As we previewed last season, we're introducing a new way to unlock your customizations! 

    Instead of having to complete specific tasks to unlock customizations, you'll now be able to earn Style Tokens by playing normally and use them to unlock the customizations of your choice, allowing you more freedom to play what you enjoy while still being able to unlock what you want. 
[h1]    MORE LEGO TECHNIC! [/h1]
    [img]https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/Lego_f536a658d1.png[/img]

    We have more LEGO Technic cars headed your way! 

    This season will feature 2 new cars, the LEGO Technic Lamborghini Revuelto and the LEGO Technic Ferrari FXX K, but it doesn't end there!

[h1]    Extra Info: [/h1][h2]    Ultimate Pass [/h2]
    A brand new layer of premium rewards and benefits for you to complete during the season! It's also packed with goodies such as: 
[list]    [*]        30 Blueprints for the Pagani Zonda Cinque     [/*]    [*]        Legend Pass    [/*]    [*]        15 Legend Pass Tiers     [/*]    [*]        5 Wildcard Blueprints for each Class     [/*]    [*]        15 Seasonal Card Packs     [/*]    [*]        +5 Extra Fuel     [/*]    [*]        500 Style Tokens     [/*]    [*]        10,000 Tokens     [/*]    [*]        20,000,000 Credits     [/*]    [*]        5,000 VIP XP     [/*]    [*]        100% boost to RP gains     [/*]    [*]        100% boost to TC gains     [/*][/list]
     
[h2]    Legend Pass Changes [/h2]
    As promised in our Roadmap, we're bumping up the Legend Pass with boosted rewards and without changing the price. 

    You'll be able to fully appreciate the changes once the update is live but here's a quick summary of changes: 
[list]    [*]        Increased total Credits awarded from 3,130,000 to 6,630,000.     [/*]    [*]        Increased total Tokens awarded from 1,250 to 3,000.    [/*]    [*]        Increased Blueprints awarded for the 6 featured cars from 5 to 8 BP. (Unite Pass Car unlock remains unchanged)     [/*]    [*]        The Body Kit Card Packs awarded have been changed to Seasonal Card packs and increased from 2 to 5 packs.     [/*]    [*]        Wildcard Blueprints have been increased to 3 for all classes.     [/*][/list][h2]    Multiplayer Changes [/h2]
    We're opening the doors to our World Series for a final hurrah before the reset. 
[h3]    World Series Changes [/h3][list]    [*]        5th Round + Bonus Round: This season will feature one last round and a Bonus round as we prepare for a new MP reset next season.     [/*]    [*]        Car filters: We're removing all the car filters and the free try cars. It's time to prove if you have the garage to match your skills!     [/*][/list] [h3]    Season Series [/h3]
    Green Streak Changes: We've been playing close attention to the feedback on the new mode, and we're going to be boosting the amount of Nitro included in the green bottles accross the board. 1st placed drivers should notice a significanty improvement to their nitro gains, as it will offer a closer experience to driving in a normal race, and those coming in last will receive a MUCH larger nitro boost than before. Hopefully these changes will make the mode more enjoyable, and we'll continue to keep an eye on your feedback as always. 
[h3]    Overall Changes [/h3]
    Increased Season Score gains in smaller lobbies: We've boosted the amount of series score gained when participating in lobbies which are not full, as players have shared they are facing smaller lobbies of players in multiplayer, particularly in the higher leagues. 
[h2]    More accessible Import Parts [/h2]
    To make it easier to upgrade your cars, you'll now be able to directly purchase with tokens any missing common or rare Import Parts directly from the upgrade screen! 

     [img]https://asphalt9.assets.gameloft.com/assets/image_50_835e85ebbf.png[/img]

    We're introducing 2 new quality of life changes in our shop, to make it easier to navigate and less cumbersome overall: 
[list]    [*]        Multipacks: We're bundling up offers for the same car to help save some space. Now you'll be able to select the cars in the shop, and you will be shown a pop-up that includes all the offers available for that car.     [/*]    [*]        Car filter and Search: Looking for deals for your favorite car? Now you'll be able to search the shop and display any available offers for the car of your choice!    [/*][/list][h2]    Aptoide Support[/h2]
    We will no longer be supporting the Aptoide store for Android.

    If you downloaded Asphalt Legends from their storefront, please make sure to have your account linked in the CONNECT screen of the settings menu, to ensure your progress isn't lost when reinstalling.

notes.title: Korean Spring Season Update
notes.content:
We have a special update coming up, packing 2 seasons, and one of our most awaited game modes: The Gauntlet!

This update is also packed with new features such as the new VIP system, Event Spotlights, new Unlock and Reward animations, and a new exclusive MP car, and much more!

Our 2 new Seasons will also each feature their own special guest stars, as Hyundai will be headlining our Korean Spring Season, and we'll let you guess who will be joining the following Toyota & Lexus Season.

[h2][b]Gauntlet Mode[/b][/h2]

It's finally happening! The Gauntlet is coming to Asphalt Legends Unite!

A new competitive mode that will have you set a time on 5 random tracks with your best cars, and challenge other player's times to rise up the ranks!
With League, Rank and Daily rewards to collect, our star prize for our top racers will be none other than the Devel Sixteen.

Don't miss out on our exclusive playthrough for a sneak peek on what to expect.

[h2][b]Exclusive MP Car[/b][/h2]

We continue to make our multiplayer even better! You'll now be able to unlock an exclusive Multiplayer car, the Ford GT Mk IV, by progressing through your milestones and ranking up in multiplayer events!

[h2][b]New VIP System[/b][/h2]

Level up through our new VIP system to earn permanent bonuses for your account. More details below.

[h2][b]New Spotlights[/b][/h2]

A new style of events! Get straight into the action with Free Try Cars available and tracks changing each day, the challenge will be to try and get your hands on as many Spotlight Collectibles as you can! 
These will earn you Spotlight Coins which you can trade in for the rewards of your choice each event! 
Make sure to get your rewards before the Spotlight ends, as Spotlight Coins will convert to credits once the event ends.

[h2][b]Extra Info:[/b][/h2]



[h2][b]VIP System[/b][/h2]

A new VIP system is coming to Asphalt Legends Unite, allowing players to earn VIP Experience points in-game and progress through a series of 10 VIP levels, each unlocking permanent rewards for your account!

You'll be able to earn VIP experience in all sorts of ways, including daily gifts, through events, as Unite Pass rewards and also VIP experience points will be included in bundles in our store.

Here are the permanent account bonuses you'll unlock at each level:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/7a1e0008c2210ed7d4fce442fa35261c4a0e2901.jpg[/img]

Improved Event End Rewards: We've also boosted the rewards provided at the end of each event for your final leader board position and rank to make it each event more rewarding!
Unified Rewards: In order to allow for a more focused grind towards unlocking our featured cars, we will no longer be including Blueprints for the Free Try Cars in our rewards.

[h2][b]New RETRY Button[/b][/h2]

[h2][b]New UI Animations[/b][/h2]

We've spruced up some of our menu animations, adding some extra shine and dazzle to our most special moments, such as Unlocking a new Car, opening card packs or receiving rewards. 

Have a look and let us know your thoughts in Discord.

[h2][b]Club Access Resolved[/b][/h2]

Our Legends will now be able to leave clubs once more, allowing for Club management and recruitment efforts to resume as normal. 

[h2][b]Android Performance[/b][/h2]

Improved performance on certain devices, particularly those using Adreno GPUs.

[h2][b]Car Balancing - Mercedes-Benz CLK-GTR Buff[/b][/h2]

This car is currently underperforming compared to other cars in a similar rank, particularly in our Season Series, where car rank takes more prevalence in matchmaking.

For this reason we'll be boosting its Nitro and Handling stats at Stock, while also giving a slight increase to Nitro at Max.

Improved Nitro at Stock
Slight increase to Nitro at Max level
Improved Handling at Stock

A brand-new update is upon us, and we're finally ready to show off everything included in the celebrations!

In this update, we've included some serious quality-of-life improvements to Career mode and private lobbies, and one of our most epic collaborations is making a return with a new game mode!

[h2][b]Collector Game Mode[/b][/h2]

It's finally happening! LEGO is making a return to the tracks, and we're introducing Collector Mode alongside it!

You'll have to wait until our upcoming Gold Pursuit season to get your hands on the all-new LEGO Technic Chevrolet Corvette Stingray, which will be a fun addition to any Garage.

The Collector Mode itself is a spin on our Time Attack Mode:
[list]
[*]You'll start the race with a limited amount of time and your goal is to grab as many collectibles as you can!
[*]Each one collected will extend your race time slightly, with more time gained if your car has a higher rating.
[*]Your final score will be based on the total amount you are able to collect!
[/list]
The LEGO Technic Chevrolet Corvette Stingray will be the first of a total of 4 new LEGO cars that we will be releasing throughout the next few months, so stay tuned for more news!

[h2][b]Private Lobby -- Single Player[/b][/h2]

Our Community has asked for this a lot, and we're more than happy to oblige! 

You'll now be able to start a private lobby all by yourself, without the need to populate a lobby first or ask a friend to join in.

This will be the easiest way to practice on new tracks with any car in your Garage and without spending precious fuel.

[h2][b]Career Mode Updates[/b][/h2]

[*]Rebalanced Rewards: We've also updated a few rewards across the board, including resources, Card Packs and Import Parts, to make the process of unlocking and upgrading required cars smoother.
[/list]
These changes are part of a wider effort to breathe some new life into the early stages of Asphalt, so expect to see more changes coming in future updates.

The team is very interested in hearing your feedback on our reward selection as we'll continue to work on it throughout the year... Oh! And keep an eye out for next update, as we'll have more surprises in store!

Here are the cars that will be featured in our League Packs next update and which you can expect to be updated regularly:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/766efd6c3788024e55cfde9e2d328e2de9aa50bc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/bdc8ed496a2c525bffd875084766bb705bd8df47.jpg[/img]

We're slightly nerfing the Pininfarina H2 Speed, as we noticed it was performing a bit above it's car ranking, especially at stock. 

For this reason, we're slightly reducing it's Nitro and max top speed. The car should maintain a similar feel when driving it at max, but will require a little more skill at stock to maximize its nitro. We hope this change will make the car feel more in-line with its displayed rank and add some variety to the meta. 

[b]Bentley Continental GT3 [/b]

We think the Bentley Continental GT3 could use some love. This car can be a bit moody and requires some skill to get used to its suspension, but we felt it was still underperforming even once players took time to learn the play-style. 

To help boost overall performance without impacting the playstyle, we're increasing the car's Nitro, to hopefully increase the results and overall appeal of the car. 120 FPS setting returning to Android Android players will now be able to set their Frames per second to 120 in the settings.

The top speed for the Nissan GTR was inconsistent between in-game and stats. This has now been resolved.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/f4bc604276d5e47ecd9ef8822446653c54a2cdd3.png[/img]
Asphalt Legends Unite is launching on Wednesday, July 17th. We’re finally unveiling to the world everything we’ve been working on for the past years, and the team couldn’t be more excited. 

Here’s all the new features, all the new game modes, all the new cars, and all the new seasons headed your way for the release of Asphalt Legends Unite. 

[h2][b]Cross-Platform[/b][/h2]

Cross-play and cross-save will be activated at last. Take on the world as you’ll be able to play against any friend or foe that crosses your path. With cross-play, all our racers will manage to race against anyone, no matter their platform, making for a faster and more competitive multiplayer experience. 

You’ll also be able to switch devices yourself, as cross-save will be active across select platforms, allowing you to quickly jump from one platform to another seamlessly. 

[h2][b]New Friends List and Private Lobbies [/b][/h2] 

Keeping track and playing with your friends has never been easier! Add your regular co-pilots to your friends list and invite them to a private race with our new Private Lobbies, 

You’ll be able to invite up to 7 other friends, choose your track, and race any car you own to prove once and for all who the best racer is. No fuel or tickets required. 

[h2][b]New Track – Singapore [/b][/h2] 

We have an all-new track for you to explore, inspired by the beautiful city of Singapore. 

You’ll be able to drive through its vibrant nightlife, as you race amongst city lights, swerve through an amusement park , and speed down water slides to reach the finish line. 

[h2][b]New Co-op Game Mode – Team Pursuit  [/b][/h2] 

In Asphalt Legends Unite, we’re giving you the first-ever opportunity to team up with other racers to achieve victory. 

Get thrown into this epic chase, by taking part as either the Syndicate Team or the Security Team. 

The Syndicate drivers will be faced with using their guile and teamwork to escape the chasing security forces. You’ll have to put your skills on display to avoid getting taken down and reaching the finish line. 

On the other hand, the Security drivers will be going all in to take down the escaping Security drivers. They’ll have to coordinate their movements to set the perfect trap and not allow the syndicate drivers to escape. 

Get ready for some exciting chases and unhinged mayhem! 

[h2][b]Improved Game – Engine [/b][/h2] 

Thanks to a Gameloft team effort, we’ve spent some time under the hood to give our game a big upgrade. 

With the inclusion of Dynamic Light effects and improved light reflections, Asphalt Legends Unite delivers a new layer of realism. 

The new Singapore track will be a wonderful place to showcase all the improvements, as the dazzling night lights reflect against the hood of your car or your new car’s headlights shine ahead of you, Asphalt has never looked better. 

[h2][b]The Beginning of a New Multiplayer [/b][/h2] 
With the launch of unite we'll also be expanding our multiplayer system, with the main objective of providing a better experience and welcome the new cross-platform era. We'll be introducing 2 new permanent events, World League and Season Series, offering both a revamped competitive mode and a new more casual experience. 

We plan to continue improving multiplayer on future updates, all while paying close attention to community feedback to keep improving the MP experience! 

[h2][b]New Garage Level Cap [/b][/h2] 

We're also increasing the game's Garage Level cap to 60! Progress through Collector Stages I & II to unlock extra daily card packs for you to claim each day!

[h2][b]Other changes:[/b][/h2]
 
[h2][b]New Multiplayer Changes [/b][/h2]

The launch of Unite along with cross-play functionality has brought a renewed focus on multiplayer. From now on, we want our Multiplayer mode to feel more dynamic and varied, as we include regular updates to ensure it feels fresh and exciting. 

Of course, we’ll be paying close attention to player feedback to make sure our changes are hitting the right notes. 

On release, we’ll be introducing 2 new permanent Multiplayer Modes: [b]World League[/b], and [b]Season Series[/b]. 

[h3][b]World League[/b][/h3]
 
Our core competitive mode. More veteran players will recognize this as our expansion on our classic World Series. With all our players uniting under one roof, and having more players competing together, we knew we needed to expand our current multiplayer and breathe some new life into it, as our players have been requesting for some time. 

The main changes coming to our competitive mode are: 

[list]
[*]Car Filters: Not all cars will be available to compete, and we’ll be changing our car rosters from event to event to keep them fresh. We also won’t be grouping cars solely based on car class, but more based on their car rank. This will allow for more balanced and interesting car selections 
[*]Sub-tiers: As we get ready for all our players to finally compete together, each tier will be broken into Sub-tiers, allowing for a larger number of players to compete and still provide meaningful progression. 
[*]New format Structure: The World League will offer the competitive experience year-round over a total of 6 Splits in the following structure: 
[*]Rounds: Competitive events lasting 2 weeks. Once complete you'll be able to claim your rewards for the Round and all players will be slightly demoted before the next round starts. 
[*]Split: A grouping made of 4 Rounds. Will aslo grant greater rewards upon completion and players will also be dropped in ranks before the next split starts.
[/list]

Once a new round starts, players will start their competitive climb, gaining ranks as usual based on your performance. 

Once the round ends, you'll be able to claim the final Round rewards. Player's total rank will also be slightly reduced before the next Round begins. Don't worry, you'll only lose a few sub tiers and won't be demoted entire Tiers at a time. 

Once a Split ends, you'll be able to claim the final Split reards, based on your perfomance over the past 4 Rounds. After a split players will also suffer a demotion. 

The end goal of course is to see how high you can climb within the competitive year! At the start of a new competitive year all competitive progress will be reset, and you'll be back to defend your claim for another year. 

You can also expect to see a few changes in rules, settings and car rotations each round, but we'll share more info on that once we're closer to the events themselves, so keep your eyes peeled. 

These changes will allow for a more finely grained level of competition, given our increase in players, and provide a longer progression system for all. 

The inclusion of Sub-Tiers will also allow for more accurate matchmaking, along with allowing us to reward players each step of the way as they unlock unique rewards and additions to the car filter. It might be a longer goal to aim for, but we’ll make it worth it every step of the way. 

Furthermore, changing our philosophy on car filters will let us break the barriers of class filters and allow for some unique matchups yet to be seen in a competitive environment. 

We hope this will also allow for a more new-player friendly introduction to the competitive series, while allowing more balanced and epic matchups in our higher Tiers. 

[h3][b]Season Series [/b][/h3]

A new multiplayer series that allows for a more casual experience! 

Here we want to offer a more relaxed and open experience, free from restrictions and car filters and allowing you to face the rest of the Asphalt Community with anything you have in your garage. 

Of course, we will still be matchmaking you against cars with a similar rank, but you’ll be free to practice on whichever car you own and get some action on your favorite rides. 

These events will last a week, and offer rewards based on your series score. 

[h2][b]New Showroom Events [/b][/h2]

These new events are headed your way: 
[list]
[*]Renault R.S.01 
[*]Vanda Electrics Dendrobium 
[*]Dodge Viper ACR 
[*]Coming in Season 2: Nio EP9 
[/list]

[h2][b]Speeders [/b][/h2]
We're also seeing a new event feature releasing with Asphalt Legends Unite: Speeders! 

On select events, keep an eye out for speeder pads: colorful pads placed on the track that will immediately give you a boost if you race over them. Take full advantage if you want to take 1st place, but careful not to crash! 

[h2][b]Balancing Changes [/b][/h2]
The team will be undertaking a new balancing project that will span several updates. Throughout this and future updates, we'll be tweaking the stats and perfomance of a few cars, both applying buffs and nerfs to a few outstanding car's whose performance does not seem to represent the car's garage rating. 

We will make sure to keep you updated via our regular patch notes of any changes coming each update. 

For this update the team will be adjusting 2 cars: 
[list]
[*]Devel Sixteen: Fixed several physics bugs that were affecting car perfomance. 
[b]Dev notes:[/b] As reported by our community, given the this car's singular shape and acceleration, the car could behave in an undesired way in certain circumstances. With these fixes, the car should be able to behave more predictively and make it more intuitive to drive. It should help set more consistent times in your races, with the car behaving more as it was intended. 
 
[*]Hennessey Venom F5: The Nitro stat has been slightly lowered to 24.07 stock and 46.00 at Max.
[b]Dev notes:[/b] This is a small nerf to bring it more in line with it's ranking in game. We felt the Nitro was a bit too high far a car with that top speed, and this should bring its performance more in line with expectations.
[/list] 

[h2][b]Nintendo Switch Bank [/b][/h2]

As Nintendo will also be switching over to the global version of Asphalt Legends Unite, their Bank feature will also be adapted to the new global standard. For this reason, Bank progress will need to be reset on Nintendo Switch, and the team will be sending the appropriate compensation to any affected accounts. 

We're sorry for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding. 

[h2][b]Device Support Changes: [/b][/h2]

Due to the increased performance requirements of the new ingame engine, we will be dropping support all the devices that have no Vulkan API support. If you require the full list of such devices, please contact Customer Care.

notes.title: ASPHALT LEGENDS UNITE IS COMING JULY 17TH
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/0b136a322d40bbb4f7093155d63c9d4541b31319.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=NJqjPBD0DnU;full][/previewyoutube]

The entire Asphalt team is excited to announce a new and bold leap forward in the Asphalt franchise, as we’re finally ready to unveil Asphalt Legends Unite to the world!

A new expansion for Asphalt 9: Legends that will bring a ton of technical updates and set the base for the future.

It’s been our best and worst kept secret, and we couldn’t wait to finally be able to share all we’ve been working on for the past year. 


[h2][b]Uniting our Players[/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=XkplmGmcDyo;full][/previewyoutube]

Asphalt is renowned for its online multiplayer, and we’re bringing you the chance to play with your friends!  

With Cross-play, we’re able to open the doors to a new world of possibilities, as you’ll be able to both play with and against others, no matter which platform you choose to play on.

The team is also hard at work to bring you more fun stuff for you to do with your friends, as we will also be introducing Private Lobbies, for you to challenge your friends directly, and we’re also hard at work to implement a new Friends list, to help keep track and invite your friends even outside of clubs.

We’ll be focusing on the release of cross play for the launch of Asphalt Legends Unite and continue to introduce Private Lobbies with plans to include Friends lists once ready, so if we’re not able to make it for launch, you can expect them to be included in following updates.

After all, the launch Asphalt Legends Unite is just the start for us, and we’ll continue to offer more game changing updates in the following months. 

[h2][b]New Co-op Game Mode [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/d2b4a068e769226cce02df75285d0ddfe100a9f8.png[/img]

Another first for us! Asphalt Legends Unite will feature a new mode that will have 2 teams face each other in an exhilarating Police car chase!

A team of 5 Syndicate drivers will be chased down by 3 Security cars, in a brand-new game mode that will have you barreling down challenging tracks and trying to either take down your foes or make your escape!

This game mode was actually inspired by our loving community (with a shoutout to Admega, check him out on YouTube), and we can’t wait to see how you react! Will you embrace the cooperative aspect and come up with new strategies? Or will it be every car for themselves and embrace the crashing chaos?  


[h2][b]Improved game engine [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/61d58fc3a4eb98a25d551784fb5f27f21596c327.png[/img]

We’re upping our game even further, as Asphalt Legends Unite will also be launching with the next evolution of our custom graphics engine.

This next step will bring more realism to our races, offering high fidelity visuals with vastly improved dynamic lighting and reflections on our tracks.  

It has also allowed us to add a lot more details to the cars themselves, with detailed car paint reflections, which will represent your choice of paint finish and even adding headlight lighting effects.

Asphalt has never looked better! 

[h2][b]Fresh Identity [/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/97d7fb7bccd912cc3a22ed04a1a1bb8e6fcea967.png[/img]
Speaking of paint jobs, Asphalt Legends Unite will also be sporting a whole new look and feel, as we introduce a brand-new UI for both the menus and in-game HUD.

You’ll also be able to easily navigate Asphalt Legends Unite menus and browse your collection of cars in an all-new Garage, which offers you the best place to truly appreciate your car collection and even customize them to your liking.

Exclusive Supercharged Editions

To celebrate the launch we’re also preparing a little surprise. We’re going to be releasing a physical edition in a few months for PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch which you can pre-order soon!

Kickstart your garage with a classic selection of cars, a useful bundle of resources and an exclusive decal for PS5 to celebrate our PlayStation Debut!

[h2][b]The Supercharged editions will include:[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] 3 star Lamborghini Countach LPI 800-4 
[*] W Motors Lykan HyperSport
[*] Chevrolet Corvette ZR1
[*] McLaren 765LT
[*] Ferrari 296 GTB
[*] Porsche Taycan Turbo S
[*] 5,000 Tokens
[*] 5,000,000 Credits
[*] Exclusive PlayStation Decal for the Lamborghini Countach LPI 800-4 (Exclusive to PS5 edition) 
[/list]

[h2][b]This is just the start![/b][/h2]

The launch of Asphalt Legends Unite is a huge milestone for us, but only one of many we have planned down the road.

The team is already hard at work on future updates we have planned for the game, including new social features, a revamped multiplayer progression, a new vanity system, a packed esports calendar and much more!

We’ll be sharing a lot more details closer to the launch of Asphalt Legends Unite and will continue to do so in the future, as we plan to keep our community in the know with upcoming Roadmaps and Dev chats. 

So don’t miss out and join our Discord!

A new type of reward is coming into the game! Keep your eyes peeled for this super valuable new item you can use to star up your cars!

If you already own a car, you can exchange the Wild cards for a blueprint that is the same class and Star rating of the card!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/a1e105cb92d0284a52487d88f564dcbc7b92fa9d.png[/img]

[h3]ASPHALT BOARD: Import part trading improvement[/h3]

We heard you! The Asphalt Board survey system allows you to choose which new features you would like to work on, and this time you chose quality of life improvement for the Import part trade screen. You will now be able to select how many parts you want to sell more easily through the use of a slider.

In the next Asphalt Board survey we will be asking you what new feature you want for us to work on next, so stay tuned!

[h3]Events showcase[/h3]
[list]
[*] Special Events: Inferno Settimo Cerchio (LP-exclusive event) and Ajlani Drakuma.
[*] Our first Asphalt Board event! The community chose to have a Pagani Zonda HP Barchetta Key Hunt for this season. Stay tuned for further in-game surveys to choose future events!
[*] We will have a Legend Pass exclusive Car Hunt for the Aston Martin One77
[*] Key Hunt galore! We will also have two more Key Hunts this season: Corvette C7.R and ATS Automobili Corsa RRTurbo
[*] Starway is back! The McLaren Speedtail will kick off the Starway events for this update.
[*] New conditions for The Clash! There are new conditions that will give bonus points in certain nodes, take a close look at the fine print!
[*] Join us to celebrate Porsche Design's 50th Anniversary through two time-limited events! You will be able to get official merchandise from Porsche Design, an exclusive decal, and the Porsche Taycan Turbo S and Porsche 911 GT1 Evolution cars!
[*] Last but not least, we will be having a special season before the next update! Stay tuned to learn about all the exciting stuff coming to the game!
[/list]

[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Koenigsegg Agera RS has been added to The Clash Shop!
[*] Multiplayer rewards are being updated for Gold league and above!
[*] The Lamborghini Aventador SV Coupé and the Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 will now be available from Gold league and above.
[*] The Lamborghini Veneno and Vision 1789 cars have been added to the reward pool of the Platinum and Legend leagues.
[*] During the last update, we tested a new way to maximize your Multiplayer experience: The Multiplayer Bonus Pass! At some point during this update, this new Pass will be released worldwide.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Race times in the post-race screen were not being displayed correctly for Seasonal Events. We have now fixed this issue.
[*] We fixed an issue that caused Multiplayer badges not to be seen in the Windows leaderboards.
[*] An issue preventing players from connecting their devices through HDMI to Samsung TVs has been fixed.
[*] An issue that caused player names to be incorrectly aligned in post-screen Multiplayer results was fixed.
[*] The Bentley Continental GT3 will be returning to its original performance power.
[*] McLaren 765LT's rear glass detachment has been fixed.
[*] Last season's new Career missions' names were not displayed in Localized languages, this has been fixed.
[*] Fixed some small issues affecting specific points of the Antarctica track.
[*] Other minor bug fixes.
[/list]

[h3]Car improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ferrari Monza SP1's brake lights intensity has been improved.
[*] Renault DeZir's brake lights intensity has been improved.
[*] Bugatti EB110's rims color and rear wheels have been improved.
[*] Lamborghini Essenza SCV12's door stickers have been fixed.
[*] We are adding a fix for the Maserati Alfieri calipers tinting.
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/0196053449d0d79584e21bb813557e0b8b687e41.png[/img]
Hello Legends,

Asphalt 9: Legends will be released on Steam next month. Which mean that you will get to play under the  "Bring the Heat" version of the game. Without further ado, let's dig into what you will be looking at! 

[u][h3][u]New cars:[/u][/h3][/u]
[list][*] Bugatti Centodieci*
[*] Bugatti EB110*
[*] McLaren 765LT
[*] Pagani Huayra R
[*] Renault DeZir
[*]Bentley Continental GT Speed* 
[*] Ferrari Monza SP1*[/list]
*These cars will have their own decal

[h3]Drive Syndicate Undercover Ops![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/48cd37507979a1fa2c317d8499c5fbce680f9d49.jpg[/img]
For the first time take control of the new security cars to chase down and intercept syndicate drivers before they can escape you to win. The mode will introduce brand-new gameplay mechanics allowing you to:
[list][*] Enter the intercept mode to gain a boost of speed allowing you to catch up to your targets.
[*] Execute a takedown at the right time to eliminate opposing cars ahead of you OR time it right to spin into a 90-degree block to eliminate an opponent approaching from behind.[/list]
This new game mode will be available only through the Drive Syndicate Special Event at this time.
Additionally, the [b]Lamborghini Murciélago LP 640 Roadster[/b] will be available to all players for the first time during this event.

[h3]Welcome to The Clash Shop![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/318d6ef300c098893fb8c2fbee07a403cc6c52c6.jpg[/img]
We're launching The Clash Shop! It's time to earn super exciting rewards for your hard-fought Club victories. You will earn now a new currency through The Clash and you will be able to spend it on a dedicated shop where you'll find lots of valuable items you won't find anywhere else in the game (including Car Keys!).

[h3]New Track[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/03a9e0ca604bda6b7b2421eb7b42b39d6fcd1169.jpg[/img]
Welcome to Greenland! Explore the icy coolness of Greenland as you drift on ice-covered roads, dodge exploding geysers, and experience the primal heat of driving through volcanic vents on a brand new track. Explore it in the new Career season and Special Events!

[h3]Events showcase[/h3]
[list][*] Enjoy three Prix events during this update! Fight for a chance to get the new Bugatti EB110 and Zenvo TSR-S in Grand Prix events, and boost your Rimac Nevera (Elite Prix)! 
[*] Get ready for stimulating Special Events! Compete for the Ferrari SF90 Stradale and enjoy a new edition of the classic Summertime Speedrush Special Event featuring Ferrari LaFerrari Aperta!
[*] Compete for Pagani Huayra R (the new King of the Class B cars!) through an LP-exclusive Special Event
[*] NIO EP9 is coming back for all players through a dedicated Car Hunt!
[*] During this update, there will be a new Unleashed event featuring the Citroën GT by Citroën car!
[*] You will have more chances at Starway events during this season! Star up your Lamborghini Huracán EVO Spyder and Peugeot Onyx cars!
[*] As usual, stay tuned for more Clash seasons to enjoy alongside your Clubmates!
[*] Last but not least, there will be a mini-season once the Bring The Heat season is over, so stay tuned to learn about all the exciting stuff coming to the game![/list]
[h3]Changes to Multiplayer[/h3]
We are bringing major changes to the Multiplayer mode!
[list][*] All the rewards have been updated
[*] We have created a new system to determine the cars available in Multiplayer events. We will have now a pool of cars (that might rotate in the future) so you can enjoy a more engaging and balanced experience.[/list]
The first pool of cars you'll be able to compete with:
[list][*]      Lamborghini Aventador SV Coupé
[*]      Lamborghini Centenario
[*]      Ferrari FXX K
[*]      McLaren 765LT
[*]      Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport
[*]      Icona Vulcano Titanium
[*]      VLF Force V10
[*]      Apex AP-0
[*]      Bugatti EB110
[*]      Apollo N
[*]      W Motors Lykan HyperSport
[*]      Lamborghini Huracán EVO Spyder
[*]      Pagani Huayra R
[*]      Bugatti Centodieci[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
New Career season!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42598558/0673cfa93d59d25dd75dd167120e490da0a58634.jpg[/img]
[list][*] We have added the 120 fps option for additional devices. Enjoy the full power of Asphalt 9 on these devices now too
[*] We fixed an issue that prevented players to see their own defense time in the first race on a specific Street of The Clash.
[*] We made changes to the Street icons in The Clash to add more clarity to their status.
[*] From now on, you can access the Player Profile screen on every leaderboard across the game.
[*] Asphalt 9 will be available on Steam this August 2022. Steam will be cross-platform with Windows and Xbox. You can start adding the game to your wishlist!
[*] We now display your Player ID on the loading screens of the game (except in the first login on a specific device)
[*] Tushek TS 900 Racer Pro headlight has been improved
[*] We fixed a bug that affected the text on the Lamborghini Essenza SCV12 car
[*] W Motors Lykan HyperSport fixes on the rear badge and brake discs.
[/list]

That's all for now. See you on the road!
